subject: Urgent: Borealis - sudden throughput drop and error spike after model upgrade
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@borealis-retail.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Dev Ops Team <devops@borealis-retail.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Production: API p99 & errors spiking after model update

Soojin,

We pushed the new model variant (v2.3) and the qprofile change earlier this morning (08:45 PST) and immediately started seeing a 3x increase in p99 latency and ~15% request errors on our hot path. This is affecting checkout flows — conversion has dropped and page timeouts are being reported by merchants.

Attached are a small sample of error traces and a chart from our observability dashboard (error-sample-logs.txt, p99-latency-chart.png). Our team rolled back client-side changes to rule that out; the timing points strongly to your rollout.

We need an urgent mitigation plan and an executive touchpoint — this is hitting revenue.

— Sophie Turner
Head of Platform, Borealis Retail
Sophie.Turner@borealis-retail.com

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@borealis-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 09:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production: API p99 & errors spiking after model update

Sophie — thanks for the heads up and the logs, appreciate the quick sample. I'm very sorry for the disruption.

Immediate plan:
- I'm authorizing an immediate rollback to the prior model variant/quant profile for your route (v2.2 / q-prod-stable).
- Rishi and I will monitor telemetry during the rollback; Marissa will coordinate comms and CS touch.
- If rollback doesn't reduce errors within 15 minutes, we'll scale a temporary Dedicated pool and route traffic to a known-good replica.

Can you confirm whether you want us to proceed with the rollback now? If yes, we'll schedule the change and share a short runbook link.

Short-term mitigation: rollback + extra capacity. Longer-term: we'll run a canary with an A/B split and run your eval prompt suite before promoting.

Attachments received. Sending to infra now.

— Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 09:31:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production: API p99 & errors spiking after model update

We pulled the rollout logs and we see a sharp increase in kernel-level queueing correlating with quant profile q2-mini that was part of v2.3. Hypothesis: the q2-mini path picks a different kernel path and introduces memory pressure under Borealis' high-concurrency signature.

Immediate actions I can take now:
- Start rollback to v2.2/q-prod-stable for Borealis route (will take ~6–8min to drain and switch).
- If rollback still shows elevated p99, activate temporary Dedicated pool (estimate 10–12min to spin up) and route 30% traffic there while we investigate kernels further.

I've posted the quick remediation runbook: https://drive.redwood.com/secure/borealis-incident-20261203 (internal runbook, access granted). Will monitor logs and share live metrics in 5 mins.

– Rishi
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@borealis-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Ops Team <devops@borealis-retail.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production: API p99 & errors spiking after model update

Sophie — confirming: we are rolling back to v2.2 / q-prod-stable now. Expect the change to complete within ~10 minutes; I will post telemetry updates as soon as we see stabilization.

Runbook link: https://drive.redwood.com/secure/borealis-incident-20261203
HubSpot case: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/BR-8621

Would you like an exec-level call after rollback to review impact and next steps? We can make Markus available if you want leadership present.

— Soojin

From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@borealis-retail.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Dev Ops Team <devops@borealis-retail.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production: API p99 & errors spiking after model update

Thanks — rollback confirmed started from our side. This issue has caused ~35% timeout rate on our checkout calls from 08:47–09:30 and we've seen an immediate revenue hit.

Yes, we want an exec call. Please include whoever is needed to talk SLAs/credits and the technical root cause. Can you also confirm whether this is related to qprofile selection or to the model weights? We need clarity for our audit.

Sophie

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Borealis exec escalation & aftermath (summary for 4pm call)

Quick summary for 4:00 PM exec sync with Borealis (they requested leadership + CS + SRE):
- Impact: checkout timeouts, ~35% timeout window 08:47–09:30 PST, estimated immediate revenue impact (customer to share).
- Trigger: rollout of model v2.3 with quant profile q2-mini. Initial telemetry shows kernel queueing and memory pressure on our hot path for Borealis concurrency pattern.
- Actions taken: immediate rollback to v2.2/q-prod-stable (completed ~09:50 PST), pro-active scaling of a Dedicated pool (on standby), full trace capture and logs attached.
- Current state: p99 has reduced to near baseline (first signs of stabilization), error rate down to ~2.1% (from ~15%). We still need to run post-mortem and add a canary gate tied to Borealis' eval prompts.
- Ask for call: 4:00 PM PST today — Markus, can you join to cover SLA/credits? Marissa, lead customer comms and next-day remediation plan. Rishi/Evelyn, prepare a short technical RCA and timeline for kernel/quant investigation.

Attachments: error-sample-logs.txt, p99-latency-chart.png

— Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
